paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5, with a change of -8.26% compared to the prior close and -14.68% over a window of 23 sessions. The price quote is as of August 28, 2026.

Recent news includes a report from Stock Titan that Fermi Inc. granted its COO, Jacobo Ortiz, a 147,059-share RSU award, with the grant vesting over three years of service. Ortiz now directly holds 5.6M Fermi shares.

There have been recent SEC filings, including multiple Form 4 filings and a Form 10-Q filing that reports a net loss for the second quarter of 2026. Additionally, Fermi Inc. has appointed Lee McIntire as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with an annualized base salary of $750,000.
